gates.title: EOS is locally activated
gates.summary: The project declares what it is and how it is verified, and the workflow profile resolves. Everything downstream reads these files, so a broken declaration is an ERROR, never a skip.

checks.title: .eos/project.json exists and validates
checks.fix: Copy your stack's block from docs/eos/stack-presets.md into .eos/project.json (projectType + stacks + commands.test).

checks.title: the declaration is not the untouched template once code exists
checks.fix: Change projectType from "config-only" to "application" (or "library") and declare commands.test.

checks.title: workflowProfile resolves in .eos/workflow.json
checks.fix: Set "workflowProfile" to a profile that exists in .eos/workflow.json (default: standard-product).

checks.title: docs/eos/activation.md tracks the one-time hardening items
checks.fix: Run /eos-init in Copilot Chat; it creates and maintains docs/eos/activation.md.

gates.title: PRD is the single source of truth
gates.summary: The PRD exists, its acceptance criteria are individually addressable, and nothing in it is still marked as an unresolved blocker.

checks.title: docs/prd.md exists
checks.fix: Run /spec to produce docs/prd.md (bmad-create-prd, validated by bmad-validate-prd).

checks.title: the PRD contains parseable AC<n>.<n> ids
checks.fix: Give every requirement acceptance criteria with stable ids like AC1.1, AC1.2.

checks.title: no acceptance-criterion id is defined twice
checks.fix: Renumber the duplicated AC ids so each one addresses exactly one statement.

checks.title: no unresolved BLOCKER / TBD marker remains
checks.fix: Resolve every line marked BLOCKER or TBD, or move it out of the PRD into the backlog.

gates.title: Story is ready for development
gates.summary: The story is context-self-contained: it references real PRD acceptance criteria, every one of them has a designed test intent (ATDD), LLM-backed criteria carry an eval case, and telemetry / authorization / rollback are concrete tasks rather than intentions.

checks.title: the story file exists and parses
checks.fix: Create docs/stories/<STORY-ID>.md with an "Acceptance criteria" table (see docs/eos/developer-experience.md).

checks.title: the story does not claim a state the ledger disagrees with
checks.fix: Remove the state: field from the story front matter and use `eos transition` — hand-edited state is not evidence.

checks.title: every referenced AC exists in the PRD
checks.fix: Reference AC ids that exist in docs/prd.md, or add the criterion to the PRD first.

checks.title: every acceptance criterion has a test intent
checks.fix: Use bmad-testarch-atdd to design one concrete test intent per AC before implementation.

checks.title: LLM-backed acceptance criteria have an eval case
checks.fix: Add an eval case id (EVAL-<n>) for every AC whose behaviour depends on model output; see docs/eos/examples/eval-starter/.

checks.title: telemetry, authorization and rollback are concrete tasks
checks.fix: Add explicit Telemetry / Authorization / Rollback lines under an "Operational tasks" section (or record SKIP + reason).

gates.title: Story is verified by executed tests
gates.summary: Tests really ran for the declared stack, every story acceptance criterion has a passing trace row, evals meet their threshold for agentic products, and the evidence belongs to the current inputs.

checks.title: the declared test command ran and passed
checks.fix: Run `node .github/hooks/project-gate.mjs` and fix failures; a missing toolchain is BLOCKED, never a pass.

checks.title: every story AC has a passing trace-matrix row
checks.fix: Produce docs/trace-matrix.md at G7 (bmad-testarch-trace) so each AC maps to a passing test.

checks.title: eval baseline met (agentic products only)
checks.fix: Run the declared commands.eval and record the result; see docs/eval-plan.md.

checks.title: the evidence matches the current inputs
checks.fix: An input moved after the prerequisite gate ran: re-run `eos check --gate story-ready --scope <STORY-ID>` first, then `eos check --gate verified --scope <STORY-ID>`.

gates.title: Release candidate is shippable
gates.summary: Every story in the release is VERIFIED with fresh evidence, security and compliance gates hold, no waiver has expired, and the operational artifacts (runbook, rollback) exist.

checks.title: all stories in the release are VERIFIED or MERGED
checks.fix: Finish or drop the unverified stories; `eos release-status` lists them.

checks.title: spec-align --strict passes (no drift, no orphans)
checks.fix: Run `node .github/hooks/spec-align.mjs --strict` and close drift/orphans/failing rows.

checks.title: secret scan is clean
checks.fix: Run `node .github/hooks/secret-scan.mjs` and remove or rotate anything it finds.

checks.title: the compliance data boundary holds
checks.fix: Run /compliance to record docs/compliance-profile.json; eos-doctor D5 explains what is missing.

checks.title: no waiver in this release has expired
checks.fix: Renew the waiver with a new expiry and approver, or close the gap it was covering.

checks.title: runbook and rollback plan exist
checks.fix: Run /runbook and record the rollback procedure before shipping.
